turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I just started a new job across town. I could take the bus or the train.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The bus stops closer to your place but takes about fifty minutes. The train is thirty, but it's a ten minute walk. Which matters more to you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Mind keeping it down, Moshi? Um, my son needs help with his shoes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Daniel, is it just me or is the bus really late today?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's not just you. The sign says twelve minutes now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It said five minutes when we got here.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Probably the roadwork on the main street again.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should we just walk? It's like fifteen minutes.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: In this rain? Let's give it five more minutes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine. But if it's not here by then, I'm walking.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: All set over here. Can you keep going?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. So, for the new job, bus or train?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I ask about something else? Is vinyl actually better quality than streaming, or is it just trendy?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's a bit of both. Vinyl sounds different, warmer for some people, but it's not technically more detailed than a good digital file.
